image_description: A high-contrast black and white image showing a metal bannister/railing system running diagonally along a staircase or ramp. The railing consists of a top handrail, vertical balusters, and decorative curved elements. In the background, there is an urban scene with buildings and what appears to be a bridge or overpass. A dark, indistinct figure or object sits atop the railing in the upper center.

artifact_observations.location: Upper center, on top of the handrail
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a large, amorphous dark mass sitting on top of the railing. It lacks clear definition, appearing like a melted or fused object (possibly a person or bag) that does not respect gravity or solid structure. It blends into the background sky/buildings.
The background elements have a 'painted' or overly smoothed texture typical of AI generation, lacking fine architectural detail. Edges between buildings and sky are slightly soft/bleeding.
The rectangular patterns on the ground/steps show slight warping and inconsistency in perspective lines, suggesting geometric instability.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the primary subject is correctly identified as a bannister/balustrade and not a generic fence or barrier.
To verify the connectivity of the balusters to the handrail and base, ensuring no floating parts or fusion artifacts in the main structure.
To analyze the depth relationship between the railing, the steps, and the background, and to check for spatial grounding errors in the amorphous object on top.
To assess the high-contrast aesthetic and identify any global noise or generation artifacts in the background.

focus_areas: Structural integrity of the amorphous dark mass on the handrail
Connectivity points between balusters and handrail/base
Boundary sharpness between railing and background
